analytic_rule.odd_block_size: representative = middle fine state; temporary attractor = representative; margin = Delta/2
analytic_rule.even_block_size: representative = either central fine state; temporary attractor = representative + Delta/4 toward block center; margin = Delta/4

interpretation: One uniform m-well SHIL stage can realize exactly the equal contiguous cyclic kernel partitions in this abstraction. Abstract digital quotients outside that geometry require additional stages or a richer physical forcing landscape.
